_doc: Town guilds (systems/guilds.js): craft guilds keyed to the industry recipes of data/markets.json and a merchants' guild in the great towns. Each lives on its settlement (settlement.guilds[id], saved with the tile): guildhall treasury, a named guildmaster, standing with the crown (-100..100), prosperity, the squeeze that drives strikes, an optional royal charter, and its market powers in its town — an outsider toll and a weekly sale cap on its goods for non-members, a price floor on the stalls' ask, a quality premium for its masters, guild rates on its inputs for journeymen. Precedence on one good in one town: a monopoly (one slot per good: the crown's by edict, a merchant house's, the player's company's or a guild's charter; a standing charter is never overridden, a crown edict fills empty slots) > the guild's own privileges > the open market. The thieves' guild is systems/underworld.js, not this.
_config: tickDays: a town's guilds take their weekly turn on its slot. minRuns: the town's own trade capacity (runs a day, SettlementMarket.tradeCapacity summed over the guild's recipes) a guild needs to form; the industry is checked monthly and the guild dissolves after declineChecks checks below half of it. membersPerRun: guild members per run a day of capacity. dues: gold a member pays the guildhall a week (x prosperity). treasuryWeeks: the hall holds at most this many weeks of dues.

config._outsiderCap: Units of each guild good a non-member may sell in the town a week: needDays x the town's daily need of it, at least min.
config._floor: The guild will not let its goods go on the stalls below floor x their base ask (a scarcity floor; chartered guilds hold a higher one).
config._squeeze: Each week a guild adds up what squeezes it (wages = the cost of bread, taxes, war levies, competition) into an average; past strikeAt for `weeks` weeks running it strikes (a hash roll under strikeChance): its trades in town halt (settlement.market.idle) for `days` and the market runs short of their goods.

_ranks: The membership ladder. fee: gold to enter the rank (to the guildhall), scaled by the town's size (typeFee). dues: gold a week. minDays: days at the rank below; minStanding: standing in this guild; skill: player.skills.commerce needed. toll: share of the outsider toll still paid. premium/inputs/loans/votes/protect: benefits held from this rank.
_guilds: Craft guilds by the recipes of data/markets.json they work (recipes), the goods they guard in town (goods: tolled, capped, floored, premium) and buy at guild rates (inputs). minRuns: the town's own trade capacity they need. masterpiece: goods a journeyman brings (from the packs) to be made master; they go to the town's market. A guild without recipes forms by population (minPop) — the merchants'.
